Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

When you attune to this pin, choose a Harper persona (Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerûn offers examples), including an alignment and a creature type. While you wear the pin, magic used to determine your creature type, alignment, or location identifies you as that persona.

Silver Harper Pin. When you attune to this pin, you can compose a general line of thought of 25 words or fewer. While you wear the pin, a creature that reads your thoughts perceives that preset line of thought instead. A creature that takes the Study action while reading your thoughts makes a DC 13 Intelligence (Investigation) check; on a success, it realizes that the thoughts it detects are preset.
